 "data": "@startuml
title Test Runner Architecture - UI & API Execution

skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

' ==============================
' Interfaces
' ==============================
interface ifTestRunner {
 + executeScript(idScript)
}

interface ifTestContext {
 + currentScript
 + capturedLogs
 + capturedErrors
 + isTestPassed
}

' ==============================
' Core Services
' ==============================
class clAuthService {
 + login(email, password)
 + logout()
}

class clReportService {
 + postRunLog(data)
 + getTestRun()
 + updateTestLog(name, data)
}

' ==============================
' Base Runner
' ==============================
abstract class clTestRunnerService {
 - ldContext : ifTestContext
 - ldReport : clReportService
 - ldTestLabData
 - lTargetUrl : string
 - ldAuth : clAuthService
 - ldLoginData

 + executeScript(idScript)
 + finalizeScript()
 # buildLogEntries()
 # resolveScriptNames()
 # findTestLabRow()
 # postAndUpdateRunLog()
 # resetContext()
}

ifTestRunner <|.. clTestRunnerService
clTestRunnerService --> ifTestContext
clTestRunnerService --> clReportService
clTestRunnerService --> clAuthService

' ==============================
' UI Runner
' ==============================
class clTestRunnerUiService {
 + executeScript(idScript)
 - runScriptActions()
 - initializeActions()
 - executeActionRows()
 - handleConnectionCreation()
 - captureCreatedDocument()
}

clTestRunnerUiService --|> clTestRunnerService
clTestRunnerUiService --> clAuthService
clTestRunnerUiService --> clReportService

' External Factories used by UI Runner
class clActionFactory
class clConnectionFactory

clTestRunnerUiService --> clActionFactory
clTestRunnerUiService --> clConnectionFactory

' ==============================
' API Runner
' ==============================
class clTestRunnerApiService {
 + executeScript(idScript)
}

clTestRunnerApiService --|> clTestRunnerService
clTestRunnerApiService --> ApiBuilderFactory

' ==============================
' API Builder Factory
' ==============================
class ApiBuilderFactory {
 + execute(config)
 - buildUrl()
 - buildParams()
 - buildPayload()
 - validateResponse()
}

ApiBuilderFactory --> clAuthService
ApiBuilderFactory --> ifTestContext
ApiBuilderFactory --> Cypress

' ==============================
' Cypress External System
' ==============================
class Cypress {
 + request(options)
 + log(message)
}

' ==============================
' Runner Factory
' ==============================
class clTestRunnerFactory {
 + create(...)
}

clTestRunnerFactory --> clTestRunnerUiService
clTestRunnerFactory --> clTestRunnerApiService

@enduml
